units.source_text: 传右卫门看内藏助还是一副谨慎小心的谦虚态度，生怕自己说的不够完整，与此同时更加敬佩他高尚的品行。

en.t: Den'emon saw that Kuranosuke was still modest and careful, worried that his own words had not been complete enough, and at the same time admired Kuranosuke's noble character all the more.

units.source_text: 他原本是对着内藏助的，这个时候又开始向京都值勤的小野寺十内，比刚才更卖力气的展现自己的钦佩之心。

en.t: He had originally been addressing Kuranosuke, but now he turned again toward Onodera Junai, who was stationed in Kyoto, and showed his admiration even more eagerly than before.

units.source_text: 他这种稚童般的热情，让以学问很多的十内感到好笑又可爱，

en.t: This childlike enthusiasm of his seemed both amusing and endearing to Junai, who was very learned,

units.source_text: 他厚道的顺着传右卫门的意思，详细的讲起了内藏助为了蒙骗仇人家派出的细作，

en.t: So Junai kindly followed Den'emon's wishes and began to tell in detail how Kuranosuke had tried to deceive the spies sent by the enemy house,

units.source_text: 裹着法衣，流连于升屋的名妓夕雾屋里的逸事。

en.t: the story that he put on a Buddhist robe and spent his time in the room of Yugiri, the famous courtesan of Masuya.
